image_conditioned_cases.selection_rationale: Evaluate whether narrow parts, gaps, and disconnected-looking details survive single-view reconstruction.
Evaluate planar faces, sharp edges, symmetry, and mechanically regular geometry.
Evaluate how matting and image conditioning handle view-dependent appearance and weak object boundaries.
Evaluate curved, irregular surfaces without strong geometric primitives.
Evaluate hallucination and topology when the visible silhouette does not fully determine the hidden structure.

text_conditioned.prompt_template: A studio product photograph of {subject_description}. One isolated object, centered and fully visible, shown from a three-quarter front view on a plain light-gray background, with even diffuse lighting and soft minimal shadows. High object-background contrast, realistic materials, sharp focus. No people, no hands, no stand, no surrounding props, no text, no logo, no watermark, no cropped parts, no duplicate objects.

cases.subject_description: a vintage mint-green metal desk fan with five blades, a circular wire cage, and a compact rounded base
cases.challenge: thin cage wires and repeated radial structures
cases.analysis_focus: Whether FLUX preserves a single coherent wire cage and the correct blade count before 3D reconstruction.

cases.subject_description: a compact teal steel toolbox with a raised folding handle, two silver latches, and slightly rounded corners
cases.analysis_focus: Whether planar faces, bilateral symmetry, handle attachment, and latch geometry remain consistent.

cases.subject_description: an asymmetric translucent amber glass perfume bottle with a faceted clear stopper and a curved silhouette
cases.analysis_focus: How the text-to-image depiction of transparency constrains the opaque surface reconstructed by TRELLIS.2.

cases.subject_description: a small freestanding sculpture shaped like an intertwined weathered tree root with branching knots and a broad stable base
cases.analysis_focus: Whether branches remain separated and whether hidden concavities are plausibly completed.

cases.subject_description: a stylized compact lunar rover toy with four ribbed wheels, a small tilted dish antenna, and an asymmetric instrument box
cases.challenge: multiple components, count consistency, and asymmetry
cases.analysis_focus: A candidate limitation case if FLUX changes wheel count, merges components, or hides the antenna attachment.
